phases.objective: Convert failed push-time Work Map currentness on exact main from a recurring manual repair into a deterministic, fail-closed, SHA-bound post-merge convergence loop that delegates mutation only to the registered generated-artifact writer on a non-protected branch.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec Kit Work Map Integration, read-only main convergence dispatcher, and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Spec Kit Work Map Integration completes with failure for a push event whose head branch and live exact head are main.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher reproduces deterministic Work Map-only drift without repository mutation and delegates the exact main SHA to work_map_self_hosting_bootstrap on chore/work-map-main-sync-<sha12>; the writer creates or validates that branch, regenerates bounded Work Map artifacts, pushes without force, reads back the exact result head, and dispatches read-only verification while main and Production remain untouched.
steps: Accept only a failed Spec Kit Work Map Integration workflow_run whose source event is push, source branch is main, and source SHA still equals the live main ref; manual recovery requires the exact same main SHA plus REQUEST_WORK_MAP_MAIN_CONVERGENCE.
Checkout the exact source main SHA with persisted credentials disabled and re-read origin/main before reproduction.
Require platform-work-map-generator --check to demonstrate stale state; if Work Maps are already current, perform no delegation.
Generate Work Maps twice locally, require the dirty set to stay under docs/work-maps, require identical binary diff SHA-256 across both passes, and require a final currentness check to pass.
Derive one SHA-specific target branch chore/work-map-main-sync-<sha12> and re-read live main before any delegation.

If the target branch is absent or still equals the exact source main SHA, dispatch the governed generated-artifact writer; if an already-converged generated-only descendant exists, stop idempotently; reject unrelated branch collisions.
Invoke only work_map_self_hosting_bootstrap with create_from_main=true, source_main_sha equal to expected_head_sha, and the typed generated-artifact confirmation.

Inside the writer, reject main and Production targets, validate the Work Map convergence branch namespace, require exact live-main equality, create the target branch only from that exact main SHA, and never force-push.

Run the existing deterministic Work Map bootstrap recipe, bound changed files to registered Work Map outputs, commit only generated artifacts, require pre-push exact-head CAS, and require post-push remote readback.
Dispatch read-only PR Generated Artifact Refresh verification on the resulting exact branch head; PR publication and merge remain separate governed actions.
assertions: A failed Work Map Integration run from a stale main SHA cannot start a repair.
A non-push event, non-main branch, successful source run, or malformed SHA cannot start automatic main convergence.
The classifier/delegator has contents read only and performs no git commit, git push, direct protected-ref update, force push, or PR merge.
The stale classifier reproduces only docs/work-maps drift and requires deterministic two-pass generation before delegating mutation authority.
The target branch identity is derived from the exact source main SHA, making retries idempotent and preventing cross-main branch reuse.
Existing target reuse is accepted only for the exact source seed or an already-converged generated-only descendant; unrelated branch contents fail closed.

create_from_main is accepted for work_map_self_hosting_bootstrap only under the SHA-specific Work Map convergence branch pattern or for the pre-existing Repository Inventory convergence recipe under its own pattern.
The generated-artifact writer still rejects main and Production as mutation targets and preserves exact-head CAS, bounded changed paths, post-push readback, and no-force-push semantics.
The ordinary Spec Kit Work Map Integration gate remains read-only and continues to publish an exact-head repair candidate before failing closed on stale generated Work Maps.
No Production deployment, database or provider mutation, credential payload read, migration apply, grant mutation, or protected-branch mutation is part of this feature.

phases.objective: Observe the first exact-main failed Work Map currentness run after this authority is trusted on main and verify automatic SHA-specific branch creation, governed regeneration, read-only exact-head verification, and idempotent retry behavior.
blockers: The dispatcher and create_from_main Work Map authority are not trusted until this source change merges to main; the first post-merge canary must remain non-protected and review-gated.

phases.objective: Exercise stale workflow_run heads, main movement during reproduction, nondeterministic generation, dirty-set escape, pre-existing unrelated target collisions, seeded-target retry, already-converged target retry, writer CAS failure, and verifier-dispatch failure.
Use the first real post-merge Work Map drift as a bounded canary with exact main identity and no protected-ref mutation.
Keep Production entirely outside this repository-generated-state convergence path.
